name: Wolfgirl
overview: Lily has grown up in the comfort of her wolf family. Always running and hiding from John, the local hunter who wants to take her to a zoo. But all of that is about to change when she meets Matthew, a 19-year-old hunk in the woods. All her memories of the wolves and the forest are stripped from her. Will she remember in time? Or will she be left with only distant howls?
